cues: Watch the young man's verbs in the first half: he senses disapproval, resents advice, assumes why the boy's head is shaved, suspects the old man of annoying him on purpose.
He reads the street like a text, from a distance.
His wife has fewer lines but more courage: she makes the first friendly touch, and at the birth Winton gives her all the heroic words.
